name: UNO HYBRID

specs.notes: The Formula 1 power unit on the road: a 1.6 V6 turbo (574 PS / 422 kW at 9,000 rpm, 11,000 rpm limit) with an MGU-K on the crank, an MGU-H on the turbo and two electric motors on the front axle: 1,063 PS (782 kW) together. 1,695 kg kerb weight, 2,720 mm wheelbase, 0-100 km/h 2.9 s, 352 km/h (auto motor und sport's data). AMG Performance 4MATIC+: the rear by the hybrid V6, the front electric. System torque and the 7-speed's ratios weren't published: the torque comes from the power (a hybrid's curve), the ratios are spread for the top speed. Weight distribution (42 % front), drag and downforce are estimates.

garage.blurb: A Formula 1 power unit with number plates: a turbo V6 that revs to 11,000, four electric motors, all-wheel drive and wings that move. The fastest thing in the garage.

interior.notes: The model's: its F1-style yoke and carbon cockpit (cut out by box); a paddle-shift automatic: the hands stay on the wheel.
